summary: From inside the oven: the host peers in through clearing smoke at the roast, which then bursts into flames.
framing: Low-angle POV from inside the oven looking out through the rectangular opening: roast on a tray in the foreground bottom centre, host's face above it; static. Starts dark and fades up.

cast.visible: head and shoulders, framed by the oven opening
cast.costume: light-blue suit, apron straps, lilac shirt

props: dark red scored roast on a white tray, foreground bottom centre
dark blue oven interior walls framing the view

beats.action: frame is flat dark navy, nothing readable
picture fades up through blue-grey smoke haze: host, roast and oven opening emerge, washed out and bluish
leaning in facing camera, head tilted slightly, eyes wide looking down at the roast, mouth a worried wavy line; holds still
haze thins, smoke wisps drift out to the sides; roast and face gain contrast; a yellow highlight shows on his hair
small flames spring up at both ends of the tray
flames jump to a ring around the roast; host's face and the oven walls light up bright (haze gone)
eyes widen further, pupils down on the roast, small smile-like open mouth
flames at full height, licking up over his chin and cheeks, sparks flying off; flicker continuously on ones with an orange glow
mouth opens, teeth showing; head drifts slightly left
head sways right, eyes stay fixed on the roast
head eases left again, brows raised, mouth small
mouth stretches open in a cry, teeth bared
mouth wide open (yell), brows up, head pulled back slightly
clenches teeth in a grimace, eyes still wide
mouth opens again, lower lip trembling shape; holds to the cut

notes: Camera static, agreeing with timeline.json. Frames 373-375 are a flat dark navy field (not black): treat as the shot's dark start, the fade-up begins on 376. The host never blinks. Flames are drawn in front of his face from 390 and have a soft glow; the pre-fire frames are desaturated toward blue by the smoke.
